title: HOWLAND REED LEAVES THE SWAMP
narrative: Jon gasps as life floods back into his frozen veins at Castle Black, his wounds sealed with red priest sorcery and direwolf breath. The gates creak open. From the south rides a small, wiry man in bronze scale armor astride a mud-spattered marsh garron. It is Howland Reed, Lord of Greywater Watch — the only living witness to the Tower of Joy. He unslings an oilcloth bundle containing a silver-stringed harp and a parchment bearing Rhaegar Targaryen's dragon seal. 'Twenty-eight years,' Howland croaks. 'I was waiting for you to die first. You are Aemon Targaryen, trueborn heir to the Seven Kingdoms.'

options.text: Ask Howland the question everyone has wondered: 'Why did the assassin have a Valyrian steel dagger?!'
Unite the Wildlings and Northern lords under the Targaryen-Stark banner to march on Winterfell.
Commune through the Weirwood roots with Bran Stark beyond the Wall.
Lord Wyman Manderly whispers: Send Davos Seaworth to Skagos to retrieve Rickon Stark.
Melisandre of Asshai: Gaze into the flames at Castle Black and whisper the words of R'hllor over Jon.
The High Sparrow revealed: Howland Reed admits he just threw on a muddy burlap sack to troll Cersei.
Ser Arthur Dayne is alive: Visit the Sword of the Morning at his Red Mountain bed-and-breakfast.
options.introducesPlotHole: The Red Mountain Sword Bed & Breakfast

options.text: Val, the Wildling Princess: Step into the Lord Commander's solar and embrace Jon by the crackling hearth.
